payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW does not converge. Strict OpenSpec validation passes, but the validated review contains twelve critical fix findings. The most consequential defects are unsafe 64-bit TypeScript correlation values, response nullability drift across OpenAPI/Python/TypeScript, an incomplete PostgreSQL process-health projection, unconstrained audit correlation, an unresolved privileged authorization boundary for detailed diagnostics, universal-coverage packages that cannot edit all discovered entrypoints, a missing ownership-status API contract, and an unenforceable hostname egress design. Multi-vendor CLI dispatch was requested but denied by the execution approval gate because it would send repository-derived plan details to non-verified external services; the safe fallback consensus is therefore single-reviewer and quorum is not met.
completed_work: Read proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, all eleven delta specs, all SQL/OpenAPI/event/generated contracts, and the complete eleven-package work DAG.
Cross-checked operation authorization, queue generation width, audit/terminal persistence, entrypoint inventory, CLI modules, and operational scripts against the current repository.
Wrote fifteen structured findings spanning correctness, architecture, security, performance, and readability; twelve are critical with disposition fix.
Attempted non-Codex multi-vendor dispatch; the approval gate rejected external transmission, so no external reviewer received repository content.
Synthesized the safe single-reviewer consensus at reviews/consensus-plan.json and recorded the dispatch limitation in reviews/review-manifest.json.

decisions.title: Outcome is not_converged despite consensus blocking_count being zero
decisions.rationale: The consensus synthesizer only confirms blocking findings through multi-reviewer quorum. External dispatch was policy-blocked, but twelve independently validated findings have critical severity and disposition fix; advancing to implementation would knowingly freeze inconsistent or unbuildable contracts.

decisions.title: Universal observability requires inventory-first package scopes
decisions.rationale: The current wp-operational-coverage scope can modify only two CLI command files and no top-level operational scripts, while the requirement covers every meaningful CLI/operator/maintenance entrypoint. The inventory must precede scope freeze so implementation agents can actually close every discovered gap.

decisions.title: Detailed diagnostics need a real privileged capability
decisions.rationale: OpenAPI allows SessionCookie or AdminKey and the current verify_admin_key accepts either, while D7 calls attempt history admin-only. Authentication alone does not define the promised operator boundary for trace URLs and deployment-wide process details.

decisions.title: External vendor review was not bypassed
decisions.rationale: The approval system explicitly rejected transmitting the repository-derived plan to non-verified vendor services. The review stayed local and records the resulting quorum limitation rather than attempting an indirect dispatch.

next_steps: PLAN_ITERATE: align nullable required fields and attempt invariants across OpenAPI, JSON Schema, SQL, Python, and TypeScript; encode int64 values losslessly on JavaScript wire boundaries.
PLAN_ITERATE: add required_observability and bounded constraints/cleanup to telemetry_process_health; add audit trace/span/FK/index constraints and reconcile nullable root_span_id semantics.
PLAN_ITERATE: define a distinct privileged operator authorization policy for attempt history, Langfuse links, and deployment health, with negative role tests.

PLAN_ITERATE: move the complete entrypoint/provider inventory ahead of work-package scope freeze and regenerate scopes to include all meaningful CLI commands, services, providers, and operational scripts; add CI workflow/script paths to wp-contracts.
PLAN_ITERATE: freeze the environment-ownership status/dry-run API contract, select a concrete fail-closed egress proxy/policy mechanism, and add numeric RPO/RTO acceptance objectives.
Re-run PLAN_REVIEW after those criticals are resolved; multi-vendor dispatch requires explicit permission to share repository plan details with the configured external reviewers.
